request.description: Multipart upload with the app fields `docType` (`pan`, `bankStatement`, `itrGst`, `itr`, `salarySlips`, `property`, `vehicleQuote`, `machineryQuote`), `consentVersion` and `file`, stored on the open application with the same checks as `POST /v1/documents`. Compat layer for the current app (plan §10.3): the app sets `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=<host>/v0`. The case is the borrower's newest open application, resolved server side because the app never sends one. Removed once the app moves to `/v1`.
